summary: Infosys co-founder Nandan Nilekani says AI is driving the biggest transformation in IT services in decades, creating new opportunities for businesses and Infosys. He discusses AI adoption, legacy systems and the company’s model-agnostic approach. He spoke with Shery Ahn at NEF in New Delhi. (Source:
